text:
kai: FYI — billing-bot surfaced ~120 RIs in the March bill that are showing as UNAPPLIED when we join by our standard tags. Looks like a tag key mismatch and a few regional-family mismatches. Putting a small sample in the sheet: https://redwood.slack-files/sheets/ri-inventory-sample

billing-bot: automated export ready: /shared/costs/ri-unapplied-2026-03.csv. Top rows: 
```
account_id,ri_id,account_tag_env,instance_family,region,unapplied_hours
123456789012,ri-0a1b2c3d,prod,m6i,us-west-2,184
210987654321,ri-9z8y7x6w,production,m5d,us-east-1,120
345678901234,ri-4f5g6h7j,,p4d,eu-west-1,300
```

manny: digging in — running the mapper now. command: `./tools/ri-mapper --start 2026-03-01 --end 2026-03-31 --scope per-account --output /tmp/ri-map.csv`

ops-bot: reservation-allocator job #452 failed reconciliation for 3 RIs due to tag mismatch (error: "undefined tag 'env'").

sophie: quick thought — two obvious causes: 1) instances created by autoscale groups missing the `env` tag (we lost tag-enforcement a while back), 2) some RIs were purchased as "Region" scope but instances are in specific AZ-scoped placement groups (or conversely).

jen: I can run a tag-backfill for the autoscaling groups and orphaned instances. Proposal: run backfill for `env` and `team` tags for the last 90 days, then re-run the AWS cost allocation join. Any objections? :thinking_face:

finance: if we backfill, note that AWS will not retroactively apply RIs for past bills — but this should fix ongoing usage allocation. Also: recommend we run a small conversion analysis for converting older m5/m6 RIs to a Savings Plan for more flexibility.

manny: update: mapper shows 38 RIs where the reservation-family doesn't match running-instance-family by minor suffix (e.g., m5d vs m5). These are likely fabric differences (disk-optimized purchases vs compute-only running workloads). Putting list in the sheet.

kai: ok — action plan suggestion: 1) jen run tag-backfill + enforcement policy (short-term fix) 2) manny run family-normalizer script to detect mismatched SKUs and propose reclass or exchange candidates 3) finance to model SP conversion for the top 50 compute RIs (cost delta + flexibility) 4) ops to mark clear "do not renew" for RIs that aren't salvageable.

ops-bot: queued: tag-backfill job #887, family-normalizer dry-run #21. Will post results to thread when done.

manny: commands I ran for reference: 
```
aws ce get-reservation-utilization --time-period Start=2026-03-01,End=2026-03-31 --granularity MONTHLY > /tmp/ce-util.json
python scripts/ri_normalizer.py /tmp/ri-map.csv --suggest-exchange > /tmp/exchange-suggestions.csv
```

jen: tag-backfill started. Will backfill `env` = inferred from name (prod/stage/dev) and `team` using our account mapping. ETA 3 hours. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

finance: reminder — before any conversions, we need a 6-month spend/forecast and a list of dependencies for dedicated capacity agreements. I'll prep numbers but we should prioritize converting region-scoped compute RIs to SPs where we have cross-account usage.

manny: early results from normalizer: 22 RIs are exchange-eligible (within same instance family generation), 16 appear to be legacy P-type purchases not used by any running instances and should be flagged for non-renewal.

kai: good cadence. Two risks to call out: - manual tag backfill could mis-attribute transient spot instances (we should limit backfill to stable instances >72h) - exchange operations can take time and may not be optimal if we have upcoming model migrations.

jen: noted. backfill excludes instances with lifecycle=spot and instances with age <72h. running re-check now.

billing-bot: cost-impact summary (projected monthly): potential reclaimable RI applied hours ~ 14k hours -> ~$28k/mo if we fix tagging + exchanges. CSV: /shared/costs/ri-savings-estimate.csv

sophie: we should also add a recurring inventory check to the monthly runbook: "RI allocation sanity check" that compares billing applied-hours vs inventory tags and flags >5% delta per account.

finance: agreed. I'll add a line item to the renewal checklist to require applied-hour delta <5% before greenlighting auto-renew.

kai: final calls for now. jen + manny please post results and the sheet link when done. finance & product: we'll sync Tuesday for conversion decision. Thanks all. :rocket:
